evidence_tier: exploratory repeated-session; previously inspected chronological test tails

A_nonstationarity_characterized.evidence: Matched stationary surrogate and synthetic stationary/regime controls; late-window excess 2.3-12.0 degrees, large absolute angles partly artifact.

B_numerical_stability.evidence: Corrected calcium recursion finite on all 175 real landmarks and synthetic stable-calcium control; original feedback defect localized.

C_adaptive_model_advantage.evidence: Prespecified rolling_w500 paired H20 improvement 0.6566, 95% CI [0.3261, 0.9856], 4/5 sessions.

D_distributional_improvement.evidence: H20 std ratio 0.238, covariance relative error 1.018, OOD 5.4%; MSE gain is shrink-to-mean.

E_perturbation_interpretation.evidence: Median frozen-versus-adaptive impulse cosine 0.060; no causal validation.

F_independent_biological_validation.evidence: No independent animals or matched experimental intervention in this stage.

caveats: Session 2 is not improved by the primary adaptive model.
Sessions are repeated recordings, not independent animals.
Oxygen timing was not analyzed in this stage.
No virtual perturbation is a biological intervention.
